purpose.zh-CN: 先理解算力产业链，再选择投资方式。
purpose.en: Understand the compute value chain before choosing an investment route.

business.zh-CN: 设计商卖加速芯片，代工厂收制造与封装服务费。
business.en: Designers sell accelerators; foundries earn fabrication and packaging fees.

indicators.zh-CN: 数据中心收入与毛利率
indicators.en: Data-center revenue and gross margin

indicators.zh-CN: 先进制程、封装交期与产能
indicators.en: Advanced-node and packaging lead times and capacity

indicators.zh-CN: 客户集中度与出口限制
indicators.en: Customer concentration and export restrictions

question.zh-CN: 交期缩短是产能增加，还是客户少买了？用什么证据区分？
question.en: Do shorter lead times mean more supply or fewer orders? What evidence distinguishes them?

business.zh-CN: 供应显存和存储芯片，收入受出货量、单价与产品组合影响。
business.en: Suppliers sell memory and storage chips; volume, price and product mix drive revenue.

indicators.zh-CN: HBM 供货、认证与产能
indicators.en: HBM qualification, shipments and capacity

indicators.zh-CN: 单价、位元出货与库存
indicators.en: Selling prices, bit shipments and inventory

indicators.zh-CN: 毛利率与扩产支出
indicators.en: Gross margin and capacity investment

question.zh-CN: 涨价来自持续需求，还是短期缺货？扩产后还能维持吗？
question.en: Are higher prices driven by durable demand or temporary scarcity? Can they survive expansion?

business.zh-CN: 卖整机、交换机和连接设备，也收集成与服务费。
business.en: Vendors sell servers, switches and connectivity, plus integration and services.

indicators.zh-CN: 已交付收入与订单积压
indicators.en: Delivered revenue and backlog

indicators.zh-CN: 产品毛利与客户集中度
indicators.en: Product margins and customer concentration

indicators.zh-CN: 应收账款、库存与回款
indicators.en: Receivables, inventory and cash collection

question.zh-CN: 大订单已交付并收款，还是仍可取消的积压订单？
question.en: Have large orders shipped and been paid, or are they still cancellable backlog?

business.zh-CN: 按使用时长或合约出租算力，承担设备、机房与运营成本。
business.en: Operators rent compute by usage or contract and bear equipment, facility and operating costs.

indicators.zh-CN: 同配置、地区与计费口径的租价
indicators.en: Rental rates with matching configuration, region and billing

indicators.zh-CN: 实际利用率、合约与现货比例
indicators.en: Actual utilization and contracted versus spot mix

indicators.zh-CN: 电费、折旧、融资与运维成本
indicators.en: Power, depreciation, financing and operating costs

question.zh-CN: 租价上涨后，扣除空置和运营成本，回款能覆盖设备投入吗？
question.en: After idle time and operating costs, can cash receipts cover the equipment investment?

business.zh-CN: 出租机柜和已供电空间，提供托管及互联服务。
business.en: Operators lease powered space and cabinets, with colocation and interconnection services.

indicators.zh-CN: 已供电容量、签约负载与入住率
indicators.en: Energized capacity, contracted load and occupancy

indicators.zh-CN: 新租、续租价格与客户集中度
indicators.en: New and renewal rents and customer concentration

indicators.zh-CN: 建设支出、融资到期与回报
indicators.en: Development spending, debt maturities and returns

question.zh-CN: 签约容量能按时接电吗？若并网推迟，谁承担空置与利息？
question.en: Can contracted capacity get power on time? Who bears vacancy and interest if connection is delayed?

business.zh-CN: 卖供配电、备用电源与冷却系统，另收安装和维护费。
business.en: Vendors sell power distribution, backup power and cooling, plus installation and maintenance.

indicators.zh-CN: 订单、交付周期与项目验收
indicators.en: Orders, delivery lead times and project acceptance

indicators.zh-CN: 产品毛利、服务收入与回款
indicators.en: Product margin, service revenue and cash collection

indicators.zh-CN: 单位功率成本、PUE 与水耗
indicators.en: Cost per unit of power, PUE and water use

question.zh-CN: 订单增长兑现为现金了吗？若客户延后建机房，谁先受影响？
question.en: Are growing orders converting to cash? Who is hit first if customers delay facilities?

business.zh-CN: 云厂商和应用公司把算力用于对外服务或内部业务，检验谁持续买单。
business.en: Cloud and application businesses consume compute for services or internal work; check who keeps paying.

indicators.zh-CN: 资本开支与融资租赁口径
indicators.en: Capital expenditure and finance-lease definitions

indicators.zh-CN: 云业务收入、利润与付费需求
indicators.en: Cloud revenue, profit and paying demand

indicators.zh-CN: 自由现金流与后续采购承诺
indicators.en: Free cash flow and future purchase commitments

question.zh-CN: 同一笔采购是否被重复算作多层需求？最终付费收入能支撑吗？
question.en: Is one purchase counted at several layers of demand? Can end-customer revenue support it?

glossary.zh-CN: 供给是可交付资源，需求是愿意付钱的使用；宣传计划不等于已成交。
glossary.en: Supply is deliverable capacity; demand is usage someone will pay for. Announced plans are not completed sales.

glossary.zh-CN: 已使用时长占可用时长的比例。GPU忙碌率与出租计费率不同，先问清分母。
glossary.en: Used time divided by available time. GPU activity and billable rental utilization differ; check the denominator.

glossary.zh-CN: 资本开支：建设或购置长期资产的投入。现金购买与融资租赁要分开核对。
glossary.en: Capital expenditure funds long-lived assets. Check cash purchases and finance leases separately.

glossary.zh-CN: 自由现金流：常以经营现金流减资本开支估算；各公司口径可能不同。
glossary.en: Free cash flow is often operating cash flow less capital expenditure; company definitions can differ.

glossary.zh-CN: 数据中心总耗能 ÷ IT设备耗能，观察供电冷却开销；不直接代表算力效率或利润。
glossary.en: Total facility energy divided by IT equipment energy; it tracks infrastructure overhead, not compute efficiency or profit.

glossary.zh-CN: VRAM是GPU显存；HBM是一类高带宽存储。容量与带宽是不同指标。
glossary.en: VRAM is GPU memory; HBM is high-bandwidth memory technology. Capacity and bandwidth are different metrics.

glossary.zh-CN: GPU、服务器之间传数据的通路。带宽、延迟和网络拓扑会影响多卡效率。
glossary.en: Links carry data between GPUs and servers. Bandwidth, latency and topology affect multi-GPU efficiency.

glossary.zh-CN: 一张GPU使用一小时。整机每小时与单卡每小时不能直接比较，多卡数量需核对。
glossary.en: One GPU used for one hour. Per-instance and per-GPU rates differ; verify the GPU count.

glossary.zh-CN: 目录起价是报价线索。收益还取决于实际成交、空置、费用、折旧和投入价格。
glossary.en: A catalog starting rate is a pricing clue. Returns also depend on realized sales, idle time, costs, depreciation and capital paid.
